units.source_text: 内侍的琵琶忽然停声，想见她正在悲伤愁叹。

en.t: The Naishi's biwa suddenly fell silent, and he imagined that she must be grieving and sighing sorrowfully.

units.source_text: 源氏公子将身靠在柱上，低声吟唱催马乐《东屋》之歌：“我在东屋檐下立……”

en.t: Prince Genji leaned against a pillar and softly sang the saibara song Azumaya: "I stand beneath the eaves of the eastern house..."

units.source_text: 内侍便接唱下段：“……请你自己推开门……”[\[18\]](#part1336.html#m18)

en.t: The Naishi then took up the next verse: "...please push the door open yourself..."[\[18\]](#part1336.html#m18)

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得她的歌声的确与众不同。

en.t: Prince Genji felt that her singing voice was truly unlike anyone else's.
